en: Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a rural scene with a rectangular two‑story masonry house beside a pond or millrace. A wooden footbridge with railings crosses the water in front of the building, and a woman in an apron stands on the bridge looking toward the camera. Ducks and geese swim in the pond in the foreground. Trees, shrubs, and a simple wooden fence surround the property. The architecture is plain, with symmetrical sash windows and a steep tiled roof typical of Central European farm or inn buildings. There appears to be a small sign above the main door, but it is too small and blurred to read.
